configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Default developer build. Dependencies are resolved through vcpkg (auto-bootstrapped into ./.vcpkg unless VCPKG_ROOT is set).

configurePresets.name: make
configurePresets.description: Same as 'dev' but generates Makefiles; use when ninja is not installed.

configurePresets.name: msvs
configurePresets.description: Generates build-msvs/rAthena.sln. Open it in Visual Studio or build with 'cmake --build --preset msvs --config <Debug|Release>'.

configurePresets.name: msvs-2026
configurePresets.description: Same as 'msvs' for Visual Studio 2026 (generator 'Visual Studio 18 2026', needs CMake 4.2+).
